xln.text: The Sun Empire is founded by Chacanto Intli from Orazca, uniting the city-states, but Apatzec Intli I abuses the power of the Immortal Sun in a devastating war with the River Heralds that reduces the empire to a few coastal cities and costs it Orazca.
Besieged by Brazen Coalition raids and the Legion of Dusk, the empire rises to fight off its enemies, and it retakes Orazca and pushes the Legion of Dusk back to the sea.
Apatzec Intli III captures the invaders' fleet to prepare an invasion of Torrezon, and Saheeli Rai teaches Sun Empire engineers to build dozens of mechanical dinosaurs for it.
Orazca becomes the new heart of the Sun Empire and its population explodes, and later, facing the New Phyrexian Invasion, the empire joins forces with the Legion of Dusk.

mh1.text: Sun Empire priests tap something unexpected while digging what they thought was a well.
